verdict.rationale: The product is an Agent Skill driven through the open SKILL.md format. Its programmatic surface is a set of dependency-free Python command-line tools: SVG audit, test sheets, boards, PNG rendering, favicon export, a searchable logo library and packaging. That gives agents a scriptable, if thinly documented, interface, but no documented public API (HTTP or SDK) exists, and the docs-md probe returned 404. Missing for 10: a documented public API with reference docs, an API spec or SDK, a stable interface contract, and independent corroboration of programmatic use.
